description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeOverlayController component, specifically testing the evaluateToken method with different scenarios involving UUID tokens.

classes.name: VoiceWakeOverlayTests
classes.description: A test suite containing methods to verify the behavior of the VoiceWakeOverlayController's token evaluation logic.

methods.name: guard token drops when no active
methods.description: Tests that evaluateToken returns .dropNoActive when the active token is nil.

methods.name: guard token accepts matching
methods.description: Tests that evaluateToken returns .accept when the incoming token matches the active token.

methods.name: guard token drops mismatch without dismissing
methods.description: Tests that evaluateToken returns .dropMismatch when the incoming token does not match the active token.
